column1: # Serbian, Latin script (sr-latn) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same
# format as es.tsv: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Serbian (ekavian) video-editing vocabulary (vremenska linija, traka, klip, sekvenca, fascikla, glava
# za reprodukciju, marker, prelaz, ključni kadar). No proprietary localisation resource, string
# table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are imperative
# verbs ("Sačuvaj kao…"), labels use sentence case, quotation marks are „…“, and product and format
# names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A
# native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = klip, track = traka, sequence = sekvenca, timeline = vremenska linija, bin = fascikla,
# playhead = glava za reprodukciju, marker = marker, In/Out point = ulazna/izlazna tačka, keyframe =
# ključni kadar, frame = kadar, caption = titl, preset = predložak, template = šablon, workspace =
# radni prostor, gain = pojačanje, opacity = neprozirnost, render = renderovati, ripple =
# talasasto, dissolve = pretapanje, wipe = brisanje, transcript = transkript, voice-over =
# naracija, proxy = proksi, (Legacy) = (zastarelo).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see sr-latn.tsv.attribution.
